يستمجدوا (form X)
# يَسْتَمْجِدُوا (yastamjidū) /jas.tam.d͡ʒi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# يُسْتَمْجَدُوا (yustamjadū) /jus.tam.d͡ʒa.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
